## Concerns
- claim-1 correctly shows source-30 states the numerical equality only conditionally on Conjecture 4.10.
- claim-2 establishes \(J_{v_m}^{A_m}=I_{w_m}^{A_m}\), hence preservation of generator number within \(A_m\).
- claim-3 is decisive: no supplied accepted internal theorem with a durable locator proves
  \[
  \mu_{A_m}(J_{v_m}^{A_m})=\binom{2m}{m}\qquad(m\ge1).
  \]
  Thus the named numerical certificate is not established.

## Unresolved certificates
- [source-refresh] Supply the exact accepted internal theorem, all hypotheses, and immutable locator asserting for every \(m\ge1\) that
  \[
  \mu_{H^\star(GL_{4m}/B,\mathbb Z)}
  \!\left(\mathbb Z\text{-span}\{\sigma_u:u\ge v_{2m,2m,m+1,4m}\}\right)
  =\binom{2m}{m},
  \]
  with \(\mu\) counting homogeneous generators in the full ambient graded ring, not merely inclusion-minimality in \(\Lambda/I_{2m,2m}\).
